contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [---] IVS AVG ; R/ VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, possibly of Constantius II (323-361), Two Victories issue of 347-348, probably Trier mint; Reece period 17. Obverse description: bust diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---] IVS AVG. Reverse description: two Victories facing each other, probably holding wreaths. T between figures. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN. Diameter: 13.7mm, Weight: 1.50gms, die axis: 12
